for fn in ['inputs/scogs_animals.zip','inputs/scogs_fungi.zip']:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(fn) as z:
        files=[i.filename for i in z.infolist() if not i.is_dir()]
        print(fn)
        for pred,name in [(lambda f:f.endswith('.faa.mafft'),'mafft'),(lambda f:f.endswith('.faa'),'faa')]:
            sel=[f for f in files if pred(f)]
            print(name, len(sel))
        bases_mafft={f[:-6] for f in files if f.endswith('.mafft')}
        bases_raw={f for f in files if f.endswith('.faa')}
        print('raw_without_mafft', len(bases_raw-bases_mafft), sorted(list(bases_raw-bases_mafft))[:5])
        print('mafft_without_raw', len(bases_mafft-bases_raw), sorted(list(bases_mafft-bases_raw))[:5])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, collections

def read_heads(b):
    return [line[1:].strip() for line in b.decode().splitlines() if line.startswith('>')]
for fn in ['inputs/scogs_animals.zip','inputs/scogs_fungi.zip']:
    species=collections.Counter(); combos=collections.Counter()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(fn) as z:
        for name in z.namelist():
            if not name.endswith('.faa.mafft'): continue
            heads=read_heads(z.read(name))
            labs=[]
            for h in heads:
                # show likely prefix before separators
                lab=h.split('|')[0].split()[0]
                labs.append(lab)
                species[lab]+=1
            combos[tuple(sorted(labs))]+=1
    print('\\n',fn,'species',species)
    print('top combos')
    for combo,c in combos.most_common(10): print(c, combo)
PY"
